''), email: String(body.email ?? ''), message: String(body.message ?? '') } const errors = validateContact(input) if (Object.keys(errors).length) { setResponseStatus(event, 400) return { ok: false, errors } } return { ok: true, name: input.name.trim() } }) E cat > app/composables/useFavorites.ts <<'E' export function useFavorites() { const favorites = useState('favorites', () => []) const loaded = useState('favorites-loaded', () => false) function load() { if (loaded.value) return loaded.value = true try { favorites.value = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('favorites') || '[]') } catch { favorites.value = [] } } function toggle(slug: string) { favorites.value = favorites.value.includes(slug) ? favorites.value.filter(s => s !== slug) : [...favorites.value, slug] localStorage.setItem('favorites', JSON.stringify(favorites.value)) } const isFavorite = (slug: string) => favorites.value.includes(slug) return { favorites, load, toggle, isFavorite } } E cat > app/app.vue <<'E' E cat > app/error.vue <<'E' E cat > app/layouts/default.vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/index.vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/about.vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/books/index.vue <<'E' E cat > 'app/pages/books/[slug].vue' <<'E' E cat > app/pages/contact.vue <<'E'
